programme.desc: A new homeowner learns that her property is where the first Thanksgiving took place, and then she must fight to keep her house because a historian wants to raze it in order to study the historic site.

Eudora: Frances Sternhagen. Sam: G.D. Spradlin. Sarge: M. Emmet Walsh. Hauer: Richard Bradford. Directed on location by John Korty.

programme.title: Reluctant Nanny
programme.desc: A lone officer desperately seeks a nanny for two children awaiting foster care, while Libby, jobless in LA, grapples with her future. Their paths cross due to a petty theft.

programme.title: The Reading Room
programme.desc: Tale of a widower (James Earl Jones) who's determined to make a reading room available in the tough inner-city neighborhood where he and his wife grew up. Joanna Cassidy, Tim Reid, Georg Stanford Brown (who also directed).

programme.title: Advance And Retreat
programme.desc: An ambitious junior executive is reunited with her first love at a corporate retreat and ultimately realizes that she might have to take a step back to make a leap forward.

programme.title: Gentle Ben 2: Black Gold
programme.desc: In this sequel, the use of land abutting the wilderness sparks conflict for Fog (who owns the land) and Jack. Rather than drill for oil, Fog says he'll open a natural spring-water business, but Jack doesn't believe him, and ends up being jailed for sabotaging the operation.

programme.title: Love Will Keep Us Together
programme.desc: After years of hiring housekeepers to run his home, a single advertising executive loses his job and becomes a stay-at-home dad. His new role gives him a different perspective on his family, but a tempting job offer threatens to lead him back to his old workaholic ways.

programme.title: Happily Never After
programme.desc: Kate is part of a writing duo with her boyfriend, and thinks her author days are over when they split, until her publisher requests a sequel.

programme.title: Time Capsule
programme.desc: After 10 years, a group of high school friends reunite at their alma mater's field house to dig up their time capsule. When they open the time capsule they decide to relive their fun high school moments which inspire a newfound relationship.

programme.title: Class
programme.desc: A rich law student (Justin Bruening) must help a single mom (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe) find a job with benefits as part of an assignment for his public-advocacy class. Though the pair clash at first, they soon realize they aren't so different and that they each need to go after the careers they truly want. Directed by Dave S. Cass Sr.

programme.title: The Long Shot
programme.desc: A troubled young mother pins her hopes on winning an equestrian event after her husband leaves her to raise their daughter alone.

programme.title: Undercover Angel
programme.desc: A young girl prays for an angel to help her mother restore their home. But they get more than what they bargained for.

programme.title: Captains Courageous
programme.desc: Rudyard Kipling's tale about a spoiled heir (Kenny Vadas) who learns the value of friendship and work when he's rescued at sea by fishermen and forced to earn his keep. Capt. Troop: Robert Urich. Dan: Kaj-Erik Eriksen. Wade: Robert Wisden. Mrs. Troop: Sandra Nelson. Michael Anderson directed.

programme.title: The Seven Year Hitch
programme.desc: A slacker tries to prevent his best friend and roommate from marrying the wrong man by claiming their seven-year cohabitation makes them common-law spouses.

programme.desc: A journalist (Laura Leighton) returns to her rural hometown to visit her ailing mother (Angie Dickinson) and discovers that many of the area's farmers are selling their land to a casino developer because of an extreme drought. Directed by Stephen W. Bridgewater.

programme.desc: Missie three years later: being a single mother after her husband Willie was shot during a poker scuffle. She and Maddy move back in with her parents Clark and Marty. programme.desc: Slice of Americana about the impact of WWII on a Southern hamlet. Barnard Hughes. Pastine: Sada Thompson. Rosh: Robert Prosky. Henry: Bill Pullman. Francine: Elizabeth Berridge. Lonnie: Neil Patrick Harris. Billy: Kyle Chandler. Hilton: Wallace Wilkinson. Filmed in Georgia. Adapted by Robert Inman from his novel. Directed by Glenn Jordan.

programme.title: It Had to Be You
programme.desc: An ad exec whose boutique agency was swallowed up by her powerful father's firm, begrudgingly becomes attracted to the office rival she's force to work with on an important account.

programme.title: Love Will Keep Us Together
programme.desc: After years of hiring housekeepers to run his home, a single advertising executive loses his job and becomes a stay-at-home dad. His new role gives him a different perspective on his family, but a tempting job offer threatens to lead him back to his old workaholic ways.

programme.title: The Michaels
programme.desc: A manicurist predicts that an unlucky-at-love lawyer will meet the love of her life and he will be a Michael, so the attorney begins a series of dates with men with that name.

programme.title: Perfect on Paper
programme.desc: A book editor embarks on a fresh start in work and romance after relocating to Los Angeles, where she learns about not judging a book by its cover after meeting two intriguing men: a surfer and a lawyer.

programme.title: The Reading Room
programme.desc: Tale of a widower (James Earl Jones) who's determined to make a reading room available in the tough inner-city neighborhood where he and his wife grew up. Joanna Cassidy, Tim Reid, Georg Stanford Brown (who also directed).

programme.title: The Wishing Well
programme.desc: A jaded journalist (Jordan Ladd) travels to a small town to write a piece about its reportedly magic wishing well. While at the well, she and a young girl (Jadin Gould) make the same wish and set off an unusual series of events that shows the woman how her life could be different. Jason London, Ernest Borgnine, Sally Kellerman, Yeardley Smith and Charles Shaughnessy also star. Directed by David Jackson.

programme.title: Soda Springs
programme.desc: A man named Eden finds redemption during a trip back to his hometown.

programme.title: Fielder's Choice
programme.desc: A perfectionist adman (Chad Lowe) becomes a surrogate dad when the death of his sister lands his rambunctious nephew (K'Sun Ray) in his care. George Segal. Holly: Marin Hinkle.

programme.title: Uncorked
programme.desc: A workaholic (Julie Benz) finds herself in unfamiliar territory after her schedule unexpectedly clears during a business trip to California's wine country. She starts spending time with a local chef (Scott Elrod) and his eccentric family, who try to teach her that there's more to life than work. JoBeth Williams and Elliott Gould also star. Directed by David Cass Sr.

programme.title: Time Capsule
programme.desc: After 10 years, a group of high school friends reunite at their alma mater's field house to dig up their time capsule. When they open the time capsule they decide to relive their fun high school moments which inspire a newfound relationship.

programme.title: Sweet Surrender
programme.desc: After spending years in the military, a young man returns to his hometown to take over operation of his ailing grandmother's bed-and-breakfast, where he must contend with an old flame who's scheming to get the property turned into a mall.

programme.title: Though None Go with Me
programme.desc: Elizabeth Leroy devotes her life to serving God but her faith is tested over the years as she has to overcome many hardships and sorrows.

programme.title: Love on the Vines
programme.desc: A young lawyer works for six weeks at a vineyard to inherit it.

programme.title: The Persian Version
programme.desc: Leila is an Iranian American woman who strives to find balance and embrace her opposing cultures. When her large family reunites in New York City for her father's heart transplant, she keeps everyone at arm's length -- until a secret is revealed.

programme.title: The Price of Fitting In
programme.desc: A mother's worst nightmare comes true when her teenage daughter begins hanging out with the wrong crowd at school. As her daughter's drug addiction puts a strain on their relationship, she must decide how best to save her daughter.

programme.title: Balestra

programme.title: Akilla's Escape
programme.desc: A drug dealer finds his moral code challenged when he interrupts an armed robbery and captures one of the gang members who is a 15-year-old boy.

programme.title: Corner Gas

programme.title: Corner Gas
programme.desc: Lacey is the unlikely champion of an eating contest; Emma enjoys the pleasures of an MP3 player.

programme.title: Transplant
programme.desc: As Bash's future at the hospital hangs in the balance, he diagnoses a young patient with a rare disease that could have been prevented; Mags is faced with a case she cannot solve, as June tries to keep her personal life private.

programme.title: Metal Shifters
programme.desc: After a meteorite crashes to Earth, a bacteria is released that kills humans on contact. When the bacteria latches on to an iron statue, it brings the statue to life to send it on a destructive rampage.

programme.title: Once Were Brothers: Robbie Robertson and The Band

programme.title: Devotion

programme.title: The Amazing Maurice

programme.title: Unsung Hero

programme.title: Monster

programme.title: The Pod Generation

programme.title: Dark Side of the Ring

programme.title: Alien: Romulus

programme.title: Something You Said Last Night

programme.title: Daniel's Gotta Die

programme.title: Chris Redd: Why Am I Like This?

programme.title: Cold Road

programme.desc: Five years after events of the first film, teenager Finn has rebuilt Bricksburg into a post-apocalyptic wasteland. When Emmet is plagued by a vision of an impending cataclysm, he and Lucy fight to protect their beloved city from invaders. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Chris Pratt, Elizabeth Banks and Will Arnett.

programme.title: Oppenheimer
programme.desc: Biographical drama starring Cillian Murphy and Emily Blunt. During the Second World War, American physicist J Robert Oppenheimer and fellow scientists race against time to develop an atomic bomb before the Nazis. But, during the 1950s Red Scare, his name is dragged through the mud by US officials.

programme.title: A Star Is Born
programme.desc: Musical romantic drama starring Lady Gaga and Bradley Cooper. Rock star Jackson Maine meets aspiring songwriter Ally, a waitress who moonlights as a bar singer. Mesmerised by Ally's talent, Jackson invites her to perform with him and she becomes a sensation. The two begin a romantic relationship, but their happiness is threatened as an increasingly washed-up Jackson grapples with substance abuse issues.

programme.title: Jerry Maguire
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Tom Cruise, Cuba Gooding Jr and Renee Zellweger. As a top agent at Sports Management International, Jerry Maguire knows his way around and is his own man... until one day he gets an attack of decency and finds himself out of a job. Now he must start from scratch. His only allies are a single mother, her cheeky young son and a second-rate player for the Arizona Cardinals.

programme.title: A Quiet Place: Day One
programme.desc: Sci-fi horror prequel starring Lupita Nyong'o and Joseph Quinn. New York City is suddenly attacked by terrifying alien creatures with super-sensitive hearing. Sam, a terminally ill cancer patient, and law student Eric are among those who have survived the initial assault - but how long can they remain alive when the faintest noise can be deadly?

programme.title: Dune: Part Two
programme.desc: Epic sci-fi drama starring Timothée Chalamet and Zendaya. With the evil Harkonnen family back in charge of Arrakis, deposed heir Paul Atreides and his mother have taken refuge with the native Fremen in the planet's perilous desert wasteland. Paul becomes close with Fremen warrior Chani and begins to demonstrate powers that persuade her people to aid in the young man's plan to avenge his father and take back control.

programme.title: Ghostbusters: Frozen Empire
programme.desc: Supernatural adventure starring Paul Rudd, featuring Bill Murray and Dan Aykroyd. The spook-hunting Spengler family joins forces with the original Ghostbusters, whose work is continuing via a secret research lab. When an ancient artefact is discovered and releases an evil force, the team must work together to prevent the dawning of a new Ice Age.

Revealed as a former operative of a powerful and clandestine organisation known as 'Beekeepers', he sets out on a brutal quest of vengeance, hunting those responsible for the incident, who have seriously underestimated how much of a threat he is. Action thriller, starring Jason Statham, Jeremy Irons, Minnie Driver and Jemma Redgrave.

programme.title: Last Action Hero
programme.desc: Comedy action adventure starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, F Murray Abraham and Austin O'Brien. Fictional supercop Jack Slater gets some help from an unexpected quarter when a magic ticket transports 11-year-old fan Danny Madigan into his latest film. However, the pair soon run into trouble when the ticket falls into the hands of screen villain Benedict, who decides to try his hand at crime in the real world.

programme.title: Arrival
programme.desc: Science-fiction drama starring Amy Adams and Jeremy Renner. After 12 alien spacecraft land in locations around the world, linguistics professor Louise Banks is called in to try to decipher the visitors' language and open a line of communication. Do they come in peace or is humankind on the brink of war?

programme.title: The Great Escaper
programme.desc: Former Royal Navy officer Bernie Jordan is happily settled with wife Rene at a care home. Unfortunately, he hasn't secured a place on the official British Royal Legion trip to France to the commemorate the 70th anniversary of the D-Day landings. Bernie needs to make the trip to Normandy for personal reasons, and with Rene's blessing, he sneaks off to pay his respects. Drama, starring Michael Caine and Glenda Jackson in her final film.

programme.desc: After being coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby, a young getaway driver with tinnitus, takes part in a heist which seems doomed to fail, especially as the characters involved lose touch with reality as events spiral out of control. Writer/director Edgar Wright's Bafta-winning, music-themed action thriller, starring Ansel Elgort, Lily James, Jamie Foxx, Kevin Spacey and Jon Hamm.

programme.title: Tropic Thunder
programme.desc: Comedy action adventure starring Ben Stiller, Robert Downey Jr and Jack Black. While filming an epic Vietnam War movie in the jungle, a group of pampered, egotistical actors find themselves fighting for their lives when they stumble across heavily armed drug lords.

programme.title: The Fall Guy
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Ryan Gosling and Emily Blunt. After a shocking on-set accident, stuntman Colt Seavers is taking some time out from the movie game. But when the lead actor vanishes from a film being directed by his old flame Jody Moreno, Seavers is persuaded to help track down the missing star and finds himself drawn into a disturbing conspiracy.

programme.title: Anyone But You
programme.desc: Bea and Ben enjoy an incredible first date, but attraction quickly burns out and they are delighted to be apart. However, fate compels the duo to reconsider, and they seize the opportunity to attend a lavish wedding in Australia, as a couple. The pair pretend to be deliriously in love during the once-in-a-lifetime trip and keep up appearances in front of other guests. Director Will Gluck's romantic comedy based on Shakespeare's Much Ado About Nothing, starring Sydney Sweeney and Glen Powell.

programme.desc: Lily Bloom returns to her childhood home of Plethora, Maine, to attend the funeral of her father, the former town mayor who beat his wife behind closed doors. Upon returning to Boston, Lily is attracted to Ryle Kincaid, a neurosurgeon with a dark side, and old flame Atlas Corrigan. Drama based on the bestselling novel, starring Blake Lively, Justin Baldoni, Jenny Slate and Brandon Sklenar.

programme.desc: Satirical fantasy comedy starring Margot Robbie and Ryan Gosling. When blonde and bubbly Barbie experiences a series of sudden crises, she must leave Barbieland to track down her human owner and make things right. But the adoring Ken follows her to Los Angeles where he discovers something called the "patriarchy" and develops some radical ideas...

Staying with her grandmother while her father is in hospital, young Bea discovers that she can now see strange creatures - which turn out to be people's imaginary friends, or "IFs". When neighbour Cal explains that the IFs are lonely because their human friends have now grown up, Bea joins him in a quest to match the IFs with new companions.

programme.title: The Wild Robot
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voices of Lupita Nyong'o, Kit Connor and Pedro Pascal. Washed up on the shore of an island, robot "Roz" learns to cope with the environment. When she encounters orphaned gosling Brightbill, Roz and wily fox Fink join forces to raise the runt.

programme.title: Despicable Me 4
programme.desc: Diabolical nemesis Maxime Le Mal and his femme fatale girlfriend Valentina target Anti-Villain League agent Gru, girlfriend Lucy, their girls Margo, Edith and Agnes and new addition Gru Jr. The family goes on the run while the Minions invade AVL HQ. Animated sequel, with the voices of Steve Carell and Will Ferrell.

programme.title: Ghostbusters: Frozen Empire
programme.desc: Supernatural adventure starring Paul Rudd, featuring Bill Murray and Dan Aykroyd. The spook-hunting Spengler family joins forces with the original Ghostbusters, whose work is continuing via a secret research lab. When an ancient artefact is discovered and releases an evil force, the team must work together to prevent the dawning of a new Ice Age.

programme.title: The BFG
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure directed by Steven Spielberg, starring Mark Rylance and Ruby Barnhill. London, 1983: ten-year-old Sophie is awake in the middle of the night when she spots a giant from the window of her orphanage home. Although Sophie hides, the 24ft behemoth grabs her and takes the little girl to Giant Country. There she learns he's actually vegetarian and extremely ancient, but he's also as unloved as she is.

programme.title: Bad Boys: Ride Or Die
programme.desc: Fugitives from the law they swore to protect, Miami cops Mike Lowrey and Marcus Burnett run a gauntlet of duplicitous police officers and gun-toting criminals in an attempt to clear their late captain's name. Fourth chapter in the action adventure franchise, starring Will Smith, Martin Lawrence, Vanessa Hudgens and Ioan Gruffudd.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Harrison Ford, Sean Connery and Denholm Elliott. When archaeologist Henry Jones disappears, his son Indiana joins in the search for him. In a desperate race against time, Indy encounters some old enemies and once again finds himself in pursuit of an ancient religious artefact.

programme.title: Inception
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Leonardo DiCaprio as a corporate spy who steals ideas from dreams. But his latest, most dangerous assignment requires him to implant a thought and it pulls him deep into a battle with his own subconscious where he is haunted by memories of his dead love.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 5
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Dwayne Johnson, Vin Diesel and Paul Walker. Fugitive Dominic Toretto assembles his old team to steal $100 million from Brazil's most corrupt businessman so that they can disappear for ever. But with tenacious FBI agent Luke Hobbs on their trail, their plan just got a lot more complicated.

programme.desc: As young serial killer Jacob Elordi and a celebrity come together on a desolate stretch of Route 66, fiery personalities clash. Mystery thriller based on a true crime story.

programme.title: Collateral
programme.desc: LA cabbie Jamie Foxx unwittingly turns getaway driver when he picks up ruthless hitman Tom Cruise. Thriller from Heat director Michael Mann. Strong language/violence.

programme.title: Captain Phillips
programme.desc: Tom Hanks stars as the captain of a container ship that is hijacked by Somali pirates in this Oscar-nominated thriller. Violence/flashing images.

programme.title: Last Seen Alive
programme.desc: When his estranged wife disappears at a petrol station, Will embarks on a frantic mission to find her before the police find him. Sky Original film starring Gerard Butler.

programme.title: Vertigo
programme.desc: James Stewart is the detective with a fear of heights driven over the edge by icy blonde Kim Novak. Alfred Hitchcock's dizzying tale of obsession and intrigue.

programme.title: Split
programme.desc: Three teens are abducted by a man struggling with dissociative identity disorder. Psychological horror with James McAvoy. Mature themes/flashing images.

programme.title: Hanna
programme.desc: Teen assassin Saoirse Ronan goes on the run from devious CIA agent Cate Blanchett. Breakneck thriller with Eric Bana. Contains strong language/violence/flashing images.
